canvas.$description: The default fill background for the entire app frame; components and panels sit on top of this

left-sidebar.$description: The fill for the drive section of the sidebar; the second section of the sidebar that lists out the drive, favorites, sharing, etc.

left-sidebar-shell.$description: Fill for the global section of the sidebar; the left most portion of the sidebar; this is the part of the double sidebar that can be collapsed

panel.$description: For right side pop out panels; used in members table for clicking on an individual member's activity; for right side asset preview panel; etc.

component.$description: For cards, modals, menus, and for radio and checkbox components in their idle state

component-shell.$description: For emphasis on frames that surround "component" fills; example includes the Code Block component

transparent.$description: Used for linear gradient shadows for hover components that overlay text or other items; example includes the buttons that appear on hover on the Folder Card

field.$description: For input fields and select fields such as dropdowns, text areas, search bars, etc.

tile.$description: Default fill for tiles; often sit on top of "component" fills; necessary to sit a level lighter on cards in dark mode

contrast.$description: For flat text areas and fills; examples include flat Tile variant and Inputs on the asset card

contrast-subtle.$description: For flat text areas and fills; examples include flat Tile variant and Inputs on the asset card

toggle-off.$description: For toggle idle state; as a note, checkboxes and radio use "component" in idle state

brand-subtle.$description: Used in the date picker component for mid-range date selection

action.$description: For focused states on action Automation blocks

favorite.$description: Star icon fill for favorited assets

scrub-line.$description: For the video scrub line on the Asset Card

hover.$description: For sidebar item fills, items that need more emphasis

scrim.$description: For overlay scrim behind center modals, on left sidebar hover, etc. Used to de-emphasize the background canvas / draw focus to the component that sits on top of the scrim

brand.$description: For toggles, checkboxes, radios, etc. when selected

brand-hover.$description: For toggles, checkboxes, radios, etc. when selected and hovered

danger.$description: Used across Button and Icon Button Danger variants

background-overlay-hover.$description: Overlay on top of (in addition to) button/neutral/background on hover
